loop.top3_why: Candidate A uses a median combination over pool2, which consists of the most stable 7 models. loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B, while a deterministic baseline, has a higher validation score (0.6909) and much larger per‑window variance (0.732, 0.680, 0.661), indicating over‑sensitivity to outlying models in the full pool. Both B and C risk overfitting to the validation windows, whereas A’s stable, robust approach aligns with the series’ noisy, low‑predictability profile.
